sys_ux_event.description: Fired every time data arrives: page changes, sort, filter, search, refresh, or any other re-fetch (including after create/update/delete). Everything except the initial load fires this. Payload: { tableName, count, total, page, hasMore }.
sys_ux_event.label: Data loaded
sys_ux_event.props: [ { "description": "The loaded table.", "fieldType": "string", "label": "Table name", "name": "tableName", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "Rows on this page.", "fieldType": "number", "label": "Row count", "name": "count", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "Total matching records.", "fieldType": "number", "label": "Total", "name": "total", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "Current page number (1-indexed).", "fieldType": "number", "label": "Page", "name": "page", "valueType": "string" }, { "description": "Whether more rows exist beyond this page.", "fieldType": "boolean", "label": "Has more", "name": "hasMore", "valueType": "string" } ]
